$Comment: What a job on the feast board pays. Every roll is read on its own: the first always pays, and the
other two are chances on top. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Festival tokens pay through the Currency reward kind, since a counter wallet has no item to hand
over; favor rides each job's own Rewards. A companion mod adds its own rolls to this table with a
file of its own that names it in ContributesTo, so nothing here has to change.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Board_Pay
